item.title: U.S. orders more diplomats to leave Middle East
item.summary: The State Department’s most recent directives apply to personnel in Turkey and Saudi Arabia, underscoring the ongoing threat posed by Iranian counterattacks.

item.title: Trump’s wearing of baseball cap during dignified transfer draws criticism
item.summary: President Trump faced continued blowback for wearing a USA-emblazoned cap during a dignified transfer ceremony for soldiers killed in the war with Iran.

item.title: Early Iran strikes cost $5.6 billion in munitions, Pentagon estimates
item.summary: The figure, accounting for the war’s first two days, is likely to intensify concerns in Congress that U.S. forces are churning through a scarce supply of advanced weaponry.

item.title: A wartime presidency defined by Trump’s unique political style
item.summary: President Trump is recasting the role of wartime leader in his image, breaking from generations of practice as he attacks his domestic enemies and revels in memes.

item.title: For Israel’s Netanyahu, Trump grants wishes, but his support carries risks
item.summary: Trump and Netanyahu, two political high rollers, are seen as more of an odd couple than Roosevelt-Churchill or Clinton-Blair. The war in Iran is their biggest gamble yet.

item.title: Trump said he ended a war in Africa. U.S. sanctions say otherwise.
item.summary: The administration says Rwandan-backed militants violated a Trump-brokered peace accord within days.

item.title: Trump confronts ‘bad part of war’ as troops killed in Iran conflict return home
item.summary: Trump joined grieving families at Dover Air Force Base for a dignified transfer as the remains of the first troops killed in the Iran war returned to the U.S.

item.title: Pakistani man convicted in Iran-backed plot to kill Trump
item.summary: Asif Merchant’s case played out amid a broadening conflict in the Middle East. He was accused of working with the Iranian government to kill high-ranking U.S. officials.

item.title: Trump is betting that bigger income tax refunds will boost the GOP
item.summary: Republicans designed parts of Trump’s signature tax law to deliver larger refunds this filing season, offering a potential political boost before the midterms.

item.title: Australia grants asylum to 5 Iranian women’s soccer players after Trump pressure
item.summary: Trump had said that if Australia didn’t take the players, criticized by Iranian hard-liners for their behavior during the Asian Cup, the U.S. would.
